fact: The National ICT Policy 2023 (June 2023, ministry text) reviews NICTP 2016 and states that most targets in its Implementation Strategy 2016/17-2020/21 were short-term, some were realized and others needed more time, and presents itself as the continuation of the 2016 policy.
title: National ICT Policy, 2023
publisher: Ministry of Information, Communication and Information Technology
